subject: Anatomy
title: Biceps Brachii Study Guide
objectives: Describe the principal actions of biceps brachii.

sections.title: Actions
sections.digest: The **biceps brachii** is a two-headed muscle that supinates the forearm and flexes the elbow.
highYield: Its most powerful action is supination of the flexed forearm.
pitfalls: Do not confuse biceps brachii with brachialis, which is a pure elbow flexor.

summary: Biceps brachii is principally a forearm supinator and elbow flexor.
